Magdiel Photography & Films

$3,700 collection

Husband-and-wife Dallas–Fort Worth photo and film team. Photography and videography are sold as separate collections, and the photo collections include albums and a design appointment.

The Classic Collection is $3,700 for 8 continuous hours with two photographers, unlimited edited images, and an online gallery. The Signature Collection is $4,900. The multi-day Legacy Collection is $9,800. Videography is priced separately, from $2,700 for the Storyteller Film. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
